{{Quote|There's one. Set for stun.|TK-9091, upon spotting Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="ANH" />}}
'''TK-9091''' was the [[Operating number|designation]]<ref name="The Bucket" /> of a [[human]]<ref name="ECUC" /> [[Gender|male]] [[Stormtrooper Commander]] who served in [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader's]] personal [[stormtrooper]] [[legion]], [[501st Legion|Vader's Fist]].<ref name="The Bucket" /> During the [[secret mission to Tatooine]], TK-9091 informed Vader that the [[Death Star]] plans were not in the ''Tantive IV''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s main [[computer]], and he and several other troopers were sent to search for [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] aboard the ship. Whilst searching the escape pod bay, TK-9091 spotted her hiding in an alcove and ordered his [[trooper]]s to set their weapons to the stun setting. The princess then shot him with her [[Defender sporting blaster pistol]], [[Death|killing]] him instantly.<ref name="ANH" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
TK-9091 appears in the [[1977]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]].<ref name="ANH" /> He was later identified in the short story "[[The Bucket]]" from the [[2017]] anthology book ''[[From a Certain Point of View]]''.<ref name="The Bucket" />

In the [[2016]] graphic novel ''[[Star Wars: The Original Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'', TK-9091 survives his confrontation with Leia Organa aboard the ''Tantive IV''. There, Organa shoots a stun blast which TK-9091 dodges and hits another stormtrooper instead, leading TK-9091 to stun Organa.<ref name="SW:TOT–AGN">''[[Star Wars: The Original Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]''</ref>
